balance.note: All numeric costs, counters and boost values are illustrative starting values, not approved balance.

runtimeContract.conditionGrammar: An expression is {all:[expressions]}, {any:[expressions]} or a typed leaf. Empty all evaluates true. Empty any is invalid.

prerequisiteScope.current_species: The same speciesId as the current research instance.
prerequisiteScope.any_species: At least one completed research instance for any species in the civilization.

runtimeContract.speciesIdRule: Required for species scope; null for civilization scope. Resolve $speciesId from the current instance, never from translated names.
runtimeContract.researchStartAndContinuation: Check prerequisites and startConditions before starting. While active, check ongoingConditions each turn. Losing access to specimens does not erase knowledge or progress.
runtimeContract.resourceRule: Availability conditions do not consume resources. Consumption is defined by action and recipe definitions. Research effects never create equipment or plants.

eurekaPolicy.speciesFilter: current research instance when $speciesId is present
eurekaPolicy.counterUnit: Each gameplay event supplies a positive amount; occurrence events use amount=1.
eurekaPolicy.grouping: A counterGroup filter restricts accumulation to one matching entity; do not sum across groups.

distinctCounters.compatible_crop_species_harvested: distinct speciesId in a compatible sequence
distinctCounters.separate_crop_line_harvest_completed: distinct lineId within the current species

eurekaPolicy.rewardTiming: Store eligibility even while locked; grant once after prerequisites and startConditions are satisfied.
eurekaPolicy.progressLimit: Clamp at research cost. An eureka cannot bypass prerequisites or start conditions.
eurekaPolicy.deduplication: Each event has a unique eventId; each reward is claimed once per research instance and eureka ID.

runtimeContract.effectRule: Completion unlocks scoped capabilities. Their use still requires usageConditions. Generational, soil and production systems implement actual outcomes. Restore capabilities idempotently when loading a save.
runtimeContract.unsupportedRulePolicy: Reject unknown condition, event or effect types. Never silently treat unresolved references as satisfied.
runtimeContract.integrationStatus: Configuration contract only. No SimulationEngine implementation is included.
runtimeContract.orderMeaning: Global display order only. Explicit prerequisites define dependencies; adjacent entries are not automatically dependent.

externalReferences.note: These are declared imports. The complete game loader must resolve them before starting a simulation. They are not implemented by this file.

designNotes: No graphics or UI state is included.
Detailed species definitions, recipes, actual domestication state and local farm improvements belong to their respective catalogs and GameState.
Plant knowledge and seed handling progress independently per species.
Irrigation, drainage, manuring and ploughing can develop in parallel according to explicit prerequisites.
No storage technology universally requires pottery.
The same species may have multiple crop-use tags.
The two example species IDs must be resolved against the future species catalog.
Technology definitions are flat. Node and branch containers have been removed; stable technology IDs, scopes and explicit prerequisites remain authoritative.

localization.missingValuePolicy: Treat an absent, empty or whitespace-only translation as missing.
localization.identityPolicy: Never use translated text as an ID, dependency, event type or save key.
localization.futureExtraction: Preserve stable IDs when moving translations to external language catalogs. Each field can later use a key such as technology.<id>.name. No external language catalogs or resolver implementation are included yet.
localization.technicalTextPolicy: designNotes, runtimeContract, balance notes and external reference notes are developer-facing English text, not player-visible strings.

description.en: Forage, cultivate and improve plant species through knowledge, equipment and local practice.
description.es: Recolecta, cultiva y mejora especies vegetales mediante conocimientos, equipos y prácticas locales.

description.en: Gather food from accessible edible wild plants.
description.es: Recoge alimentos de plantas silvestres comestibles accesibles.

description.en: Identify useful and reproductive parts of a particular plant species.
description.es: Identifica las partes útiles y reproductivas de una especie vegetal.

description.en: Enable equipped workers to harvest plants more efficiently.
description.es: Permite que los trabajadores equipados cosechen plantas con mayor eficiencia.

designNotes: Efficiency values belong to balance and production rules. Stone tools are the minimum technological prerequisite.

description.en: Enable equipped workers to carry more gathered food.
description.es: Permite que los trabajadores equipados transporten más alimentos recolectados.

designNotes: Any one container technology is sufficient. Raw materials are consumed by manufacturing recipes, not by researching or using this technology.

description.en: Separate and preserve viable seeds or other propagation material.
description.es: Separa y conserva semillas viables u otro material de reproducción.

description.en: Protect useful wild plants and clear competing vegetation.
description.es: Protege plantas útiles y retira la vegetación que compite con ellas.

description.en: Learn the general technique of planting viable propagation material.
description.es: Aprende la técnica general de plantar material de reproducción viable.

designNotes: This general technique does not automatically unlock cultivation of every species.

description.en: Apply sowing and crop care to one discovered species.
description.es: Aplica la siembra y el cuidado de cultivos a una especie descubierta.

designNotes: Wheat and maize use separate research instances identified by technologyId and speciesId. Wild ancestors and domesticated crops must be distinguished in the species catalog.

description.en: Prepare larger plots with suitable agricultural hand tools.
description.es: Prepara parcelas más grandes con herramientas agrícolas manuales apropiadas.

description.en: Supply suitable fields through constructed irrigation channels.
description.es: Abastece campos adecuados mediante canales de riego construidos.

description.en: Remove excess water where terrain and constructed drains permit it.
description.es: Retira el exceso de agua donde el terreno y los drenajes construidos lo permiten.

description.en: Apply appropriate organic materials to cultivated soil.
description.es: Aplica materiales orgánicos apropiados al suelo cultivado.

designNotes: Fertilizer quantities and soil responses are defined by production and soil rules.

description.en: Prepare more land using trained draft animals and a suitable plough.
description.es: Prepara más terreno con animales de tiro entrenados y un arado adecuado.

designNotes: Wooden ploughs do not require metallurgy. Assembled teams require both suitable equipment and trained animals.

description.en: Use more durable or soil-adapted plough designs.
description.es: Utiliza diseños de arado más duraderos o adaptados al suelo.

description.en: Schedule uncultivated periods to manage soil recovery.
description.es: Programa periodos sin cultivo para gestionar la recuperación del suelo.

designNotes: Actual recovery is controlled by soil simulation; it is not an instant fertility reset.

description.en: Organize compatible crop sequences on cultivated land.
description.es: Organiza sucesiones de cultivos compatibles en terrenos cultivados.

designNotes: The runtime must count distinct species in a compatible sequence for this event. No universal benefit is granted for arbitrary crop combinations.

description.en: Reserve viable material from a harvest for future planting.
description.es: Reserva material viable de una cosecha para futuras plantaciones.

description.en: Select plants with useful observable traits for reproduction.
description.es: Selecciona plantas con características útiles observables para reproducirlas.

description.en: Support generational changes in a cultivated population under human management.
description.es: Favorece cambios entre generaciones de una población cultivada bajo manejo humano.

designNotes: Research unlocks a management capability. Actual domestication requires generational simulation and species-specific criteria; completing research must not mark the species domesticated. Selection need not have been consciously understood.

description.en: Maintain separate lines and compare their results.
description.es: Mantiene líneas separadas y compara sus resultados.

designNotes: The eureka counts distinct harvested line IDs, not repeated harvests of one line.

description.en: Direct sustained selection toward specific crop traits and uses.
description.es: Orienta la selección sostenida hacia características y usos concretos del cultivo.

designNotes: Only species-appropriate heritable traits can be selected. Trait gains are simulated locally rather than granted to every crop on research completion.

description.en: Reproduce compatible plants through cuttings, division or other vegetative material.
description.es: Reproduce plantas compatibles mediante esquejes, división u otro material vegetativo.

designNotes: Basic vegetative planting can be supported by initial cultivation; this technology represents deliberate specialized propagation, not a universal prerequisite for planting tubers or cuttings.

description.en: Join compatible scion and rootstock material for suitable fruit crops.
description.es: Une material compatible de una variedad y un patrón para cultivos frutales adecuados.
